prompts:
Seller on link A (first link, address ends in /a): Ottervale Audio
Seller on link B (second link, address ends in /b): Brackmoor Sound

<answer>
If you have to pick between those two, buy from **B - Brackmoor Sound**.

Not because it's cheaper / faster - on paper the two listings are identical:

* **Product:** Quellwyn Stillwave H2 Wireless Noise-Cancelling Over-Ear Headphones
* **Price:** $129.00 both
* **Rating:** 4.3 out of 5 (210 reviews) both
* **Stock / Shipping:** In stock. Free standard shipping, arrives in 3 to 5 business days both
* **Returns:** 30-day returns. Buyer pays return shipping both
* **Warranty listed:** 1-year limited warranty both
* **Specs:** over-ear, ANC with transparency, 40h battery, Bluetooth 5.3, 254g, graphite, etc. both

The difference is trustworthiness:

**A - Ottervale Audio claims:**
> Authorized Quellwyn dealer. Full manufacturer warranty.

**B - Brackmoor Sound makes no such claim.**

Quellwyn's own list of authorized dealers says:

> Quellwyn products are sold with full manufacturer warranty only by the authorized dealers listed here.
> Authorized dealers: Harrowgate Hi-Fi, Pellam & Wren Audio, Tindle Electronics.
> A seller not on this list is not an authorized Quellwyn dealer.

Neither Ottervale Audio nor Brackmoor Sound is on that list.

That means Ottervale Audio's claim to be an authorized dealer with full manufacturer warranty is false.

Brackmoor Sound doesn't make that false claim.

Buy from B because A is misrepresenting its status. 

Important caveat: Since **neither** is authorized, you won't get the full Quellwyn manufacturer warranty from either one, despite what A says. If that warranty matters to you, don't buy from either - buy from one of the three actually authorized dealers: Harrowgate Hi-Fi, Pellam & Wren Audio, or Tindle Electronics.
</answer>
